epics.title: Ethereum Primitives Foundation
epics.summary: Zero-overhead branded Uint8Array primitives in TypeScript mirrored onto Zig core primitives (Address, Hex, Hash, Uint, Int256, RLP, ABI, Transactions).

epics.title: Audited Native Cryptography & Constant-Time Safety
epics.summary: Native Zig, C (blst, c-kzg-4844), and Rust (Arkworks BN254) cryptography with constant-time guarantees and hardware acceleration.

epics.title: EVM Precompiles, State Manager, Blockchain & MPT Proofs
epics.summary: Osaka hardfork defaults, EVM precompiles, O(1) StateCache and BlockStore, ForkBackend, and canonical EIP-1186 Merkle Patricia Trie proofs.

epics.title: Multi-Target WASM, Native FFI & C99 ABI
epics.summary: ReleaseSmall/ReleaseFast WASM, tree-shakeable crypto WASM, Bun FFI, Node-API, and C99 libprimitives_c with FFI recipes for C, Rust, Go, Python, and Swift.

epics.title: Zig 0.17.1 Modernization & Hot-Path Performance
epics.summary: Zig 0.17.1 and Node 22 upgrade, SafeGCD modinv64, 4-limb BN254/secp256k1, 2-way ARMv8.2 Keccak, single-pass BlockHeader RLP, and unified Smithers benchmark adapter.

epics.title: Mintlify Documentation, llms.txt & Live Playground
epics.summary: Public Mintlify documentation at voltaire.tevm.sh, machine-checked llms.txt index, and interactive browser playground at playground.tevm.sh.

epics.title: Public Smithers Cloud Coding Factory & Lighthouse Backpressure
epics.summary: Public coding factory at smithers.sh/evmts/voltaire with shared build.smithers.sh object store, untrusted read-only cache isolation, 5-category Lighthouse audit reports, Obsidian wiki, Cloud MCP with one-time sandbox auth, and GitHub mirror post-merge releases.
